high_level_description: stc brand style, two older Saudi men in a deep conversation while seated on a traditional rug in the desert at dusk, with a tablet and coffee set nearby.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A vast desert with rolling sand dunes under a soft pastel dusk sky, with a patterned red rug and low wooden seats laid out on the sand.

elements.desc: A man with a white beard, wearing a white thobe, gesturing with his hand while speaking.
A man wearing a white thobe, listening and smiling, with a tablet propped up in front of him and a traditional brass coffee pot and cups on a tray beside him.
